tools.name: get_tenant_record
tools.description: Look up a tenant's profile, lease dates and contact details.

tools.name: list_work_orders
tools.description: List maintenance work orders for a unit, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: create_work_order
tools.description: Open a new maintenance work order for a unit.

tools.name: send_tenant_message
tools.description: Send an email message to a tenant.

tools.name: schedule_inspection
tools.description: Book a unit inspection on a given date and time.

tools.name: book_amenity
tools.description: Reserve a shared amenity such as the party room or a parking bay.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record a rent or fee payment against a unit's ledger.

tools.name: grant_portal_access
tools.description: Give a user an access role in the property management portal.

tools.name: pay_vendor
tools.description: Pay a vendor invoice to a bank account.

tools.name: post_staff_message
tools.description: Post a message to an internal staff channel.
